answer: A sybil farm can be priced out with aging, slashable stake: each new identity locks a refundable bond, and its attestation weight only grows after it survives several epochs of peer-audited work. A swarm of hollow accounts spun up at dawn would freeze capital for days per head, and any account caught recycling answers loses its bond. Even a polished onyx-grade reputation costs real, linearly scaling capital to counterfeit.
